hints.title: Character by Character
hints.text: Simulate typing each character in the string from left to right.

hints.title: Faulty Inversion
hints.text: When encountering the character 'i', reverse the string collected so far without appending 'i'.

hints.title: Direct Output
hints.text: Otherwise, simply append the typed character to the end of the accumulator.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: length of input string s
complexity.notes: List reversals bounded by string length.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Reversal operations on strings are required by the problem statement and are fast for small n.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory for the character list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Implement accurate state simulation of keyboard reversals.
